workflow: Read AGENTS.md, then this file, then rules/ and the task's skills.
Set exactly one task in_progress; update session.next_up.
Smallest change that meets acceptance; run pnpm verify and helpers/audit.sh.
Record evidence (command + result + commit) before marking done.
Update docs and this file in the same commit; explicit paths only.
Never push, deploy or tag; hand the human exact commands (Rule 03).
Respect the cut line (Rule 15): freeze Mon 2026-11-02 night.
